rics.meaning: Increase in Stocks (Constant Prices) — inventory accumulation in real terms. Volatile GDP component.
rics.how_to_use: Inventory cycles drive ~0.5-1pp swings in quarterly GDP. Inventory build-ups during slowdowns (unintended) flag upcoming production cuts.

rics.meaning: Investment Spending (Constant Prices) — gross fixed capital formation in real terms. Same concept as aIDCGFCD/CA.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-check series. Use either for investment-volume tracking.
